title: Playing billiard gardens for a dollar a night, tips and the kitty
summary: Gardens served beer, crab boils; no union, a dollar a night plus tips; speakeasy and legality questions.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Was it prohibition yet? No. No.
No. No. No. No. No. No. No.
No. No. No. No. No. No. No.
No. No. They had beer. They could boil crabs when you go play there in these bill guards.
Well something like that. I guess that's what they call them.
Was liquor illegal then at that time when you came here? Yeah.

It already was. Yeah. It was already then at the time when we was playing at these places. It was legal then. Yeah it was legal. And we played at them places. It wasn't making but a dollar a night. That's all it was. It was legal. It was legal then. It was legal. It was legal. It was legal. It was legal. That's all they could pay. It didn't have no union or nothing like that. Yeah. And then you'd get tips of course.

We'd have tips. A hundred and fifty cents. We'd have like a kitty you know. We'd drop your money. Like when we'd say to the entertainer. We'd have a kitty and we'd drop money. Who else was with you there at the entertainers?
